test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
What should come at the place of question mark?.

5, 6, 19, 20, 61, 62, ?
solution:
The logic follows here,

 
• 5 + 1 = 6
 
• 6 × 3 + 1 = 19 
 
• 19 + 1 = 20
 
• 20 × 3 + 1 = 61 
 
• 61 + 1 = 62
 
• **62 × 3 + 1 = 187**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
